about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: PRO DEKLARANT - Your reliable customs partner

history.title: Company History
history.p1: PRO DEKLARANT was founded in 2014 and has become one of the leading customs brokerage firms in Uzbekistan. Our main activity is providing professional assistance to entrepreneurs in carrying out export-import operations.
history.p2: Our team consists of qualified specialists with deep knowledge of customs legislation. We advise clients not only on document processing but also on planning foreign economic activity.
history.quote: Our success depends on the success of our clients. Therefore, we approach each order responsibly.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To assist Uzbek entrepreneurs in entering the global market, eliminate customs barriers and simplify foreign trade processes for the country's economic development.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: To become the most reliable and innovative customs brokerage company in Central Asia. Create a system for providing the fastest services to clients through the application of digital technologies.
